title: From Native Memes to Global Moderation: Cross-Cultural Evaluation of Vision–Language Models for Hateful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on native, culturally grounded hateful meme datasets across six distinct cultural ecosystems to measure cross-cultural robustness, performance disparities, and systematic convergence toward Western-centric safety norms.

Evaluating model performance using native-language prompting versus English-centric prompting, and quantifying the 'translation penalty' (loss of nuanced meaning like sarcasm or dialect) by comparing results on original text versus a 'translate-then-detect' pipeline.
